stats.text: You can call on your deity or pantheon to intervene on your behalf. As a {ref:glossary/magic} action, choose any Cleric spell of level 5 or lower that doesn't require a {ref:glossary/reaction} to cast. As part of the same action, you cast that spell without expending a spell slot or needing Material components. You can't use this feature again until you finish a {ref:glossary/long-rest}.
